leads.name: King Lir (Tullynally beech)
leads.location: Tullynally Castle demesne, 'close to the house'; register beech records 205 (pollard, 53.68449,-7.32815) or 199 (53.68623,-7.32644), both 200-300 years
leads.reason: Verify pass 2026-11-03: Irish Times 'Branching out' (fetched): 'a magnificent beech close to the house which the family has named King Lir', looks like a Tolkien tree. Real and named, but no coordinate or measurement; register match is a guess (record 205 is about 145 m from the castle, 199 about 360 m). Ship when the estate places it (tree trail map).
